proposals.name: repeated_dialog_dismissal_without_restoration
proposals.description: Repeated dismissal attempts target the Function Wizard, but the dialog remains visibly open in the available frames and no formatting action is evidenced.

proposals.name: off-target retrieval path
proposals.description: The attempt pursued weather data through wttr.in and terminal commands instead of establishing the requested browser page, with no visible proof of the required result.

proposals.name: proxy access failure
proposals.description: The browser visibly reports ERR_PROXY_AUTH_UNSUPPORTED, and later terminal retrieval behavior is not fully observable; proxy failure may have blocked access.

proposals.name: Repeated control targeting misses
proposals.description: Repeated clicks miss the intended Layers-panel control, leaving the requested dialog unopened until a keyboard shortcut is used.

proposals.name: off_target_menu_navigation
proposals.description: Repeated menu clicks and shortcuts are followed by unrelated Bookmark, Fields, and Special Characters dialogs; the requested footer/page-number configuration is never visibly reached.

proposals.name: numeric_field_append_without_clear
proposals.description: Typing into the Columns field appended to the existing value, visibly producing 75 instead of replacing 2; later correction is not visibly completed and insertion is not evidenced.
